4551d4789ecfe425fdf1.text: A modal is a type of auxiliary (helping) verb that is used to ex- press: permission, prohibition or obligation. ➢ Permission – can, may, could

cd857324426a753b0ed8.text: 'Can' is most often used to ask for or give permission but 'may' and 'could' are also possible even though they are not used as often as 'can'. • Can I wash my hands? • You can use this hand sanitizer if you don’t have soap

90c494c0dd4b5ac06400.text: with you. • Could I use the computer to research more about CoVID-19? • May I get some updates about CoVID-19 cases here in Muntinlupa?

dccb616af706839611f2.text: ➢ Prohibition 'Can't' and 'mustn't' (must not) are used to show that some- thing is prohibited (not allowed)

5218c120444040d1e371.text: • You can't go outside the house without your mask on. • You mustn't touch your face especially your eyes, mouth and nose.

37bf05f3785445a574ca.text: ➢ Obligation 'Have to' and 'must' are both used to express obligation. There is a slight difference in the way that they are both used. 'Have to' shows that the obligation comes from someone else, not the speaker. This is usually referring to a rule or law.

39aed6250245f1f64167.text: • We have to stay at home to prevent getting exposed to the virus. People have to maintain physical distance to prevent the spread of CoVID-19. • The frontliners have to wear personal protective equip- ment to protect themselves from getting infected.

66f042e223bcdb6d6c6f.text: ➢ Here is an example of the difference between 'have to' and 'must':

bb1159a9e1cf1a5ee58c.text: • My doctor said that I have to get myself tested for CoVID-19 or I'll risk serious problems. (I have no choice) • I must get myself tested for CoVID-19 so that I’d be sure. (it’s my decision)

a568e3d9035f906194a4.text: ➢ We use 'don't have to' to show that there is no obligation. You can do something if you want but it is not an obligation.

67c993209d755f3f6fa4.text: • You don't have to help everyone but it would be nice to help a person and show our support with each other in the midst of this pandemic. • Students don't have to be at risk to acquire education, teachers are doing their best to equip themselves to deliver education in their stu- dents’ homes.

58a59c1cf7af2689c017.text: What are the USES of FIRST CONDITIONAL SENTENCES?

d1b54e8c3ce6710f51f8.text: A conditional sentence is a type of sentence that tells a condition and

5eacfd6f2ed88e9c0971.text: its result. It is composed of a main clause (independent clause) and a subordinate clause (dependent clause) which is also known as the if-clause.

675d9f003bb1046090bb.text: What is the function of Conditional Sentence Type 2?

3368fac26f3b849684eb.text: The second type of conditional sentence expresses dreams or unreal

65ef9747f9be80191d08.text: situations in the present or in the future. It is used in the following situations:

9c61d38a1f1b72cbe8ca.text: 1) for an occurrence or result of a condition that is impossible to fulfill;

19cf0d6d74ca8959c074.text: • If I had a superpower, I could go anywhere in just a second. (The condition “had a superpower” is fictional and cannot be fulfilled.) • Would you invite me for a cruise If you owned a private yacht? (The condition is contrary to the fact and unlikely to happen) • You are just a student. If you were a doctor, you could help to treat the COVID-19 patients. (The condition could be met but not possible to achieve.)

a83aca1da53234b20d48.text: 2) to give advice • I would not stop studying if I were you. • If I were you, I would accept the challenge.

e1d6c673af1a228b6aa0.text: What is the structure of Conditional Sentence Type 2?

rows: Affirmative If I noticed the kidnappers, If we submitted our project on time, Negative If she attended webinars, If you reminded me earlier, Interrogative If you were a millionaire, If you were forgiven,
I would call the policemen. our teacher could give us a good grade. she might not be left behind. I wouldn’t attend the party. would you share your wealth to others? wouldn’t you forgive other too?

6d4916d962357dca4a8d.text: Basically, it is composed of two clauses. The subordinate clause also known as the “if”- clause and the main clause or result clause.

0a4c42fef9ba5de701ea.text: Using Conditionals (Zero, First, Second and Third

bed2353595edecc36da4.text: In your previous lessons, you have learned about conditionals and its type

5526460ef6888375a547.text: and usage. As a review, a Conditional sentence is a type of sentence that expresses a condition and the outcome or the result of that condition. A condition is something that can occur IF something else happens.

289c00b513afe8978ae9.text: A Conditional sentence is of a dependent clause and an independent clause

e4cd587bc29f9d3a871f.text: that are put together to express the condition and the result.

edaad6f7fbeb1a977db2.text: If you stay at home, you will be safer from the threat of the pandemic.

755a9804ab1c0ead0e65.text: The if-clause tells you the condition (If you stay at home) and the main clause tells you the result (you will be safer from the threat of the pandemic).

460fb824ba795b542597.text: We use the zero conditional to talk about things about general truth, especially for laws and rules.

87aa5eb8cf49953c668e.text: We use the first conditional when we talk about the future situation that is possible to happen or can happen in reality.

9f5e53936d7d73e0cc46.text: The second conditional is used to express the present or future situation that is impossible or unlikely to happen in reality.

19851fa2b91d13bef275.text: The third conditional is used to refer to a time that is in the pastor unreal past condition and express its probable past result.

058f54980da2ba7cbcbe.text: Conditional sentences are also used to express arguments. Arguments are

51130095cdfa502d0665.text: statements expressing a reason or set of reasons given to persuade others that a certain action or given idea is right or wrong. It is also used to deliver or to present a reason or reasons why you support or oppose an idea or suggestion.

b2eeb459ddff93f84787.text: In expressing arguments using conditional sentences, you are going to present

46d437c2d0f515c408a8.text: your response as the result from a given condition (if-clause) and/or you will tell the possible or the probable cause of a certain situation or result (main-clause).

1443a0a9a071bb013d4d.text: Situation: Mary’s teacher sent a reminder in their class’ group chat that the

d8e0d43aad5b4fb87bbe.text: submission of their module would be on the day after next. John, one of her classmates, asked her to send him her answer because he forgot to work on his module. If you were Mary, would you help John finish his module by sending him your answers? Why or why not?

183d6f2c5f0e42b61c3f.text: Possible Answer: If I were Mary, I would help John finish his module, but I would not

36749f3f7c17d4c2aeb0.text: send him my answers. I would tell him to start doing his module now and help him out in understanding the lesson. I would also motivate him to answer his module ahead of time so he would not cram the night before the submission.

30955b3b14e03b598bc9.text: Make sure to use the correct type of conditional based on the form/tense of

523c32ac84e138de8fee.text: the verb given on the question/situation.

8a7880d6e3d5e2f142dd.text: Communicative styles are patterns of speaking characterized by distinctive

d6a8fd2671bb1b1aed3f.text: pronunciation, vocabulary, intent, participants, and grammatical structures.

fbb5dbdc64c96e261ae4.text: A communicative style, according to Martin Joos (1976), a linguist and

cf351bb703cb8014eebf.text: German professor, it refers to the form of language that the speaker utilized, which is characterized by the level of formality. Still, according to Joos, speech style is identified into five types: frozen, formal, consultative, casual, and intimate.

784d38773364b90155d6.text: Also known as fixed speech, it is the highest form of communicative style, which is often used in respectful situations or formal ceremonies like Shakespearean plays, weddings, funerals, and more. It uses the complex grammatical sentence structure and vocabulary that is only known by experts in that field Examples: National pledge, anthem, school creeds, marriage ceremonies, speech for a state ceremony

3a50dfe6403c3c3f206b.text: Conversational style breaks most of the grammatical rules. It is aimed at the target audience and addresses them as such. It's informal in form. Uses language that resembles conversation. It is warm and natural, easy to understand. The objective of this style is to engage the listener or readers.

a3c8f803ddb21585d083.text: Most people prefer having a conversation on how to change a light bulb than

2e2e64623a51224fa6c7.text: having to read an instruction manual. •

1cda60cc8c5252ed48f4.text: If you are a marketer on social media, selling some products.

99a63f1d1d2e5c8641f2.text: A conversation with a group of people on a threaded discussion forum.

942284c5664c65e5d195.text: In this lesson, you will discover the Communicative Styles and how,

9c5618112637f63ae01b.text: when, and where they are used.

026e7c6d1fc6429f92f4.text: Communication helps us to express our thoughts and feelings.

66c18227e9eb9de9dab4.text: Having your own styles in conveying messages and knowing these styles lead to a better understanding and successful transfer of ideas.

5f9da5ee609080fefdac.text: The purpose of the different styles of speech is to help people know

4138c2840b2338562b0c.text: the specific approach they should use in every situation, person, and place.

130679b6e55defe50f90.text: Every person has a unique communication style, a way in which they interact and exchange information with others. According to Martin Joos (1976:156), such communicative styles are levels of formality in using language which are determined by the situational context and degree of familiarity, or intimacy between the interlocutors. Each level determines what kind of language is appropriate to use in a specific context. In this lesson, you will discover the remaining Communicative Styles and how, when, and where they are used.

the
third level of language

4. Casual Style
Also known as informal style, it is usually used
between, friends, or even insiders who have things to share. In this

The last type is used in talks between two very close

Boyfriend and girlfriend expressing their feelings
